page.content:
Best knight of the world, lover of the queen, father of Galahad.

How Lancelot connects

  • Character: Guinevere — Lancelot's love for Guinevere is the court's fatal bond.
  • Faction: Round Table — Lancelot is the Table's greatest knight.
  • Character: Galahad — Lancelot is father of Galahad.
  • Character: Lady of the Lake — The Lady of the Lake fostered Lancelot.
  • Event: Grail Quest — Lancelot comes nearest of the sinful knights and still fails.
  • Character: Gawain — Gawain becomes Lancelot's enemy after the deaths at Guinevere's rescue.

What is Lancelot?

Lancelot of the Lake is the French cycle's peerless knight: raised by the Lady of the Lake, unmatched in arms, and the man whose love makes him fail the Grail and later war on Arthur.

Key threads lead to Guinevere, Round Table, Galahad, Lady of the Lake, Grail Quest and Gawain.
